scope: 111 raw originals from initial 114 unreviewed inventory; CUB/JPN/PHL excluded as parallel work. This is a targeted adjacency audit, not complete catalog validation.
method: Original GPKG opened SQLite mode=ro&immutable=1; R-tree bbox candidate lookup; original OGR Intersects/Intersection. No simplification, repair, source modification, network or runtime work.
limitations: Exact contacts only; this does not detect near gaps or prove mixed old/new source seam safety.
Areas are square degrees, not metric area. Tiny positive overlaps are recorded without asserting material geographic error.
unmapped means no matching WP_ID in inventory rawCandidates, not necessarily absent app entity. XKS is Kosovo; null-code Spain is Spain mainland.
Geometry validity and geopolitical correctness were not exhaustively revalidated. No source application approved by this audit.
